metadata.description: open-prototype: design UI prototypes as plain HTML, from a first draft to a reviewed design ready to build, against your project's DESIGN.md. For designers and AI coding agents. Local-first, with no runtime dependency.

plugins.name: open-prototype
plugins.description: The prototyping skill, and the open-prototype command on the PATH of Claude Code's Bash tool. It needs Bun 1.4.4 or newer.
